verdict.rationale: Dover documents a first-party Data Export in Settings that exports candidate data to CSV, an open format. Its own API can also fetch jobs and candidates, and signed offers download as PDF. However, the documented export covers only candidate data, not 'all of my data', and nothing describes leaving the platform. Missing for 10: evidence of a complete export (interview feedback, notes, emails, files, recordings, jobs, reports), a documented account-closure or deletion process, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the export is complete.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export your candidate data to a CSV from **Settings → Data Export**.
With the API, you can programmatically add candidates to your jobs, fetch job listings, and automate various recruitment processes.
